task: Estimate the hourly westbound I-94 traffic volume at the Minneapolis-St Paul monitoring station from recorded weather and calendar information.
context: date_time: source local timestamp; holiday: holiday name or no holiday; temp: temperature in Kelvin; rain_1h and snow_1h: precipitation in millimetres; clouds_all: cloud cover percent; weather_main and weather_description: observed weather labels. Multiple source weather descriptions can refer to the same traffic hour. This is a contemporaneous estimate, not a future-weather forecast.
